introduced: Mandatory `plugin_api` compatibility declaration, replacing `min_canopy`.
`canopy.httpStream()` for streaming HTTP responses.
`ui.dragSource()` and `ui.dropZone()` for declarative panel drag and drop.
The `string_map` plugin setting type.
The `allow_insecure_tls` HTTP request option.
The `dismiss_on_outside_click` panel entry option.
Luau closures directly in UI tree callback props.
The `keyboard_focus` panel entry option.
The `persistent` panel entry option.
`canopy.systemStats()`, `canopy.cpuCores()`, and `canopy.nowMs()`.
The `capture_keys` panel entry option and the `onKey` callback.
The `[widget.actions]` entry table, declaring bar gesture defaults.
`canopy.openSettings()`, opening the settings window at the plugin's own settings.
Per-interface network rates, sample timestamps, and disk mount/stat APIs.
Service entries start when the plugin is enabled instead of only at launch, and `onExit(signal, reason)` reports `reload`, `disable`, `uninstall`, or `shutdown`.
`panel.setNeedsFrameTick(bool)`, delivering `onFrameTick(deltaMs)` to an open panel.
Timezone support on `canopy.formatTime`, `canopy.isValidTimezone(name)`, and `canopy.timeFormat()` / `canopy.dateFormat()` mirroring `[shell].time_format` / `date_format`.
`canopy.sound.load()` and `canopy.sound.play()` for plugin audio.
The `ui.markdown` node, `submitOnEnter` on `ui.input`, and `stickToBottom` / `onScroll` / `scrollToBottomRev` on `ui.scroll`.
`require("./path.luau")` loads relative `.luau` modules with entry-local caches and hot reload for loaded modules.
`canopy.readFileAsync(path, callback)` for bounded filesystem reads outside plugin VM workers.
Argument-array form of `canopy.runAsync()` for direct process execution without shell parsing.
`canopy.wallpaperPath(connector)` and `canopy.setWallpaperMask(connector, mask)` for source-aligned desktop-widget occlusion masks.
`canopy.getSetting(path)` for reading any effective shell config value by TOML dotted path.
`frameVisible` on `ui.input` for hiding the native input background and border.
`panel.openContextMenu(request)` for native context menus in regular and persistent plugin panels.
`onPointerMove` and `onPointerLeave` callbacks on `ui.graph` nodes.
The `layer` panel entry option for choosing the layer-shell layer of a floating plugin panel.
`canopy.getColor(role)` for reading colors from the active theme palette.
The `tooltip` prop on `ui.box`, `ui.row`, `ui.column`, and `ui.image`, shown on hover.
The `revealKey` prop on `ui.scroll` for scrolling a keyed child into view.
The `hover_highlight` widget entry option for opting out of the bar's whole-widget hover highlight.
`canopy.idle.watch` and `canopy.idle.unwatch` for compositor idle notifications, available to every entry kind.
`[[layer]]` entries for plugin-owned layer-shell surfaces, with `layer.*` and `canopy.layer.show`, `hide`, and `configure`.
`canopy.calendarEvents()` for reading the shell's synced calendar events.

`ui.dragSource()` and `ui.dropZone()` in bar widgets (`barWidget.render`), not only panels; `dragSource.grabCursor` and `dragSource.onClick` for a source that wraps a whole clickable item; `expandOnDrag` grows a zone along its thin axis.
`canopy.osd.show(icon, value, opts)` for showing the shell OSD from plugins.
`ui.pixelStream` for showing frames from a companion process over a shared-memory socket protocol, with pointer, scroll, and keyboard callbacks.
`ui.colorPicker` for an inline color picker with optional alpha, hex-only or hidden inputs, swatches, and `onChange` / `onChangeEnd` callbacks.
`height = "content"` and `max_height` on `[[panel]]` entries: the panel follows the height of its rendered tree.

Container color roles (`primary_container`, `surface_container`, `surface_container_high`, `outline_variant`, `scrim`, ...). `surface_variant` and `outline` are retired as role names; use `surface_container` and `outline_variant`.
